title: MLG Airhorn
blurb: One airhorn is hype. Forty airhorns stacked over a 360-noscope while Doritos rain from the top of the frame is culture. This is 2014 YouTube in its purest and least defensible form, preserved here for modern deployment — an entire aesthetic movement built on montage parody, hitmarkers, sunglasses sliding onto faces, and the total abandonment of restraint. It has aged into something almost sincere. Use it whenever anything even mildly impressive occurs, and layer it more times than seems reasonable. Restraint was never part of the format. BRRRRT.
origin: The signature airhorn spam of MLG montage-parody culture.
